result:
Experiment 7 is pre-registered in `runs/pending_experiment.json`. The design agent's job ends here; the harness takes it from the implementation stage onward.

**What the history says.** This era's three accuracy attempts left the held-out 2024 photograph pinned: usable fix 12 to 14 percent, false fix 39 to 43 percent, across a feature-consistency loss (exp 3), a whole-frame trunk (exp 5) and cross-survey blending (exp 6). The false-fix term is three times the usable term, and every experiment's `arch_json` marks the same stages changed. The confidence gate has never been questioned in this era.

**The experiment: a two-member committee.** Two fully independent localizers, each the current trunk at slightly narrower width, each with its own cell head and offset head. Confidence is the smaller of the two members' belief on the consensus 3×3 block, so a fix survives only if both members independently back the same place. Each member trains on its own random augmentation draw of every view, with no agreement term, so the two keep different survey-specific shortcuts. On a foreign photograph those shortcuts fire differently, the members name different cells, and the frame becomes an abstention instead of a false fix.

- Family never tried in any era. Earlier honesty attempts (four-area exps 15 and 32) were learned or calibrated single-model confidence, which the library names as what fails under map change. The Prignitz rotation-consensus refutation does not apply: that averaged one model over rotations of one frame.
- Measured at design time with no training, via a probe at `runs/_probe_exp7_committee.py`: the committee exports to 3.94 MB, under the 4 MiB gate, at 2 ms host latency.
- Prediction: mission score 1.271 to 1.05–1.18 through the false-fix rate (39% to 18–28%), with usable roughly flat. The explicit risk is 2024 coverage falling toward the 0.2 FAIL floor; the pre-registration carries a decision rule for that case (retry once with the geometric mean of the two block masses).

**Next step for the loop.** The implementation agent gets a file-level brief pointing at the probe script as a working, export-verified reference. If the committee holds, the next experiment should attack accuracy on top of it with external features, which no experiment in this era has tried.
